result.title: ALBI: LLM-Guided Inductive Logic Programming via Iterative Generate-Test-Constrain Refineme
result.summary: We introduce ALBI (Agent for Learning By Induction), a neuro-symbolic ILP framework that replaces the ASP-based hypothesis generator in the Learning from Failures (LFF) paradigm with a Large Language Model (LLM), while retaining SWI-Prolog as a formal verifier. ALBI implements an iterative generate-test-constrain loop: the LLM proposes candidate hypotheses from structured prompts; Prolog tests each candidate; and diagnostic feedback drives refinement. We further introduce semantic anonymization, a metamorphic testing methodology, to distinguish structural symbolic induction from surface-level pattern matching on predicate names. Experiments on 30 standard ILP benchmarks show that ALBI achieves 100% success across three frontier LLMs (Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT 5.4 Pro, Claude Opus 4.6), matching Popper while requiring only 1.4-1.7 iterations on average. Under anonymization, all models maintain 100% success with a moderate iteration increase (1.36-1.67 times), providing evidence of robust symbolic reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 ALBI，用 LLM 替换 LFF 范式中基于 ASP 的假设生成器、保留 SWI-Prolog 作形式验证器，形成「生成—测试—约束」的迭代精化回路，并提出语义匿名化的变形测试方法来区分结构化符号归纳与谓词名称层面的表层匹配，在 30 个 ILP 基准上检验成功率与迭代次数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选生成＋外部验证器反馈精化」回路可供核查是否能类比 LVR 中的假设生成、验证与停止决策；语义匿名化的变形测试思路可能为诊断 latent 状态编码的是结构/任务必要信息还是表层线索提供评价线索，但原文属纯符号 ILP，与视觉推理无直接关联。
